Speculating about the causes of problems (Diagnosis)
Talking about career plans (Your future in IT)
grammarFocus: Present perfect and past simple; already in affirmative sentences, yet in questions and negative sentences
Speculating about causes: may, might, could (possible), must (almost certain), can't (impossible) + verb / be + -ing / be + past participle
Suggesting solutions: should/shouldn't in first conditional sentences; might; try + noun / -ing
Future plans: plan, intend, hope, expect + to-infinitive
sourceNotes: Unit 8 không có đề mẫu: toàn bộ R1–R30, W31–W35, email, Listening và Speaking viết mới theo khung đề và quy tắc 1–15.

R1–R5: thuật ngữ và định nghĩa lấy từ Workbook Unit 8 Part 1 (8A, 8B, 8C, 8D); định nghĩa của escalate được diễn đạt theo nghĩa trong bài Diagnosis của giáo trình (chuyển sự cố lên cấp hỗ trợ cao hơn). Định nghĩa thừa lấy từ Workbook 8C.
R13–R20: từ vựng lấy từ Workbook Unit 8 Part 1.
Bài đọc R21–R25 lấy cảm hứng từ bài Investigations và Diagnosis; bài đọc R26–R30 lấy cảm hứng từ bài Your future in IT. Cả hai viết mới, không dùng thuật ngữ và định nghĩa của câu nối.
Listening A lấy cảm hứng từ bài Diagnosis (track 45) nhưng đổi sang sự cố máy in; Listening B lấy cảm hứng từ bài Solutions (an toàn sức khoẻ nơi làm việc). Không chép Audio script.
Listening B: một số biến thể trong acceptedAnswers (cách viết khác của cùng đáp án) không có nguyên văn trong lời thoại, xử lý giống Unit 6.

Bản r2 (theo báo cáo et-auditor 1b23076): R7 thay phương án nhiễu "since" (vẫn đọc được ở cuối câu) bằng phương án sai rõ; R11 đổi điều kiện để lời khuyên lưu bài làm được; đoạn 2 bài đọc R21–R25 và câu R22 đổi bằng chứng loại trừ wi-fi cho chặt chẽ về kỹ thuật.

Bản r1 (tự rà theo các lỗi auditor đã bắt ở Unit 1, 4, 5, 6): R6, R12, R16, R17 đổi tình huống để không lặp chi tiết máy in và hộp mực của Listening A, làm đổ nước lên bàn phím của Listening B; R24 thay phương án nhiễu "compared" (bài không nói thẳng) bằng việc bài nói rõ là đã làm; câu dịch W33 đổi nội dung để không lặp lời khuyên máy nóng thì tắt máy của Listening B.

parts.instructions: Listen to the phone call and choose the best answer A, B, C or D (Questions L1–L5).
parts.context: Rosa, who works on the second floor, phones Dev at the help desk about a printer.

script.speaker: Rosa
script.text: Hi Dev, it's Rosa on the second floor. Our printer is printing blank pages. The paper comes out, but there's nothing on it.

script.speaker: Dev
script.text: OK. Has it printed anything else today?

script.speaker: Rosa
script.text: Yes, it worked fine this morning. The problem started after lunch.

script.speaker: Dev
script.text: Right. Is the printer showing a message on its screen?

script.speaker: Rosa
script.text: No, there's no message at all.

script.speaker: Dev
script.text: Then it can't be a paper jam, because a paper jam always shows a message. It might be the ink. Has anyone changed the ink cartridges recently?

script.speaker: Rosa
script.text: Yes! Our assistant changed the black cartridge at lunchtime.

script.speaker: Dev
script.text: Ah, that must be the reason. New cartridges have a small plastic strip on them. Your assistant may have forgotten to remove it.

script.speaker: Rosa
script.text: Let me check... Yes, the strip is still there.

script.speaker: Dev
script.text: OK. Try removing the strip, then put the cartridge back and print a test page.

script.speaker: Rosa
script.text: It's working now! Thanks so much.

script.speaker: Dev
script.text: Great. If it happens again, you should call me straight away.

questions.stem: What is the problem with the printer?
questions.explanation: Rosa nói "Our printer is printing blank pages" (máy in ra trang trắng).
"it worked fine this morning. The problem started after lunch."

questions.stem: Why does Dev say it can't be a paper jam?

options.text: The paper in the tray is new.
A paper jam always shows a message.
Rosa has already checked the tray.

questions.explanation: "it can't be a paper jam, because a paper jam always shows a message", mà máy không hiện thông báo nào.

questions.stem: What did Rosa's assistant do at lunchtime?
questions.explanation: "Our assistant changed the black cartridge at lunchtime."

questions.stem: What does Dev tell Rosa to try?
questions.explanation: "Try removing the strip, then put the cartridge back and print a test page."

parts.instructions: Listen to the talk and answer the questions. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS for each answer (Questions L6–L10).
parts.context: Gareth, an office manager, gives new staff some health and safety advice on their first day.

script.speaker: Gareth
script.text: Welcome to your first day. Before you start, here are a few health and safety points for the office.

script.speaker: Gareth
script.text: First, cables. Please don't leave cables across the floor, because people can trip and fall. If you need a longer cable, ask the IT team. Don't bring an extension cable from home. Second, drinks. If you spill a drink on a keyboard, switch the computer off immediately and call IT. Please keep your drinks on the small table by the window instead.

script.speaker: Gareth
script.text: Third, your chair. You should adjust the height of your chair so that your eyes are level with the top of the screen. If you get backache, try taking a short walk every hour.

script.speaker: Gareth
script.text: Finally, laptops. Don't use them on your bed or sofa at home, because they need air to cool down. If a laptop feels very hot, you should switch it off and leave it for twenty minutes. Oh, and the first-aid room is next to reception. Any questions?

questions.stem: Who should staff ask if they need a longer cable?
questions.explanation: "If you need a longer cable, ask the IT team."

questions.stem: What should be level with the top of the screen?
questions.explanation: Chỉnh ghế "so that your eyes are level with the top of the screen".

questions.stem: What should you try if you get backache?
questions.explanation: "If you get backache, try taking a short walk every hour."

questions.stem: How long should you leave a very hot laptop switched off?
questions.explanation: "switch it off and leave it for twenty minutes".
"the first-aid room is next to reception".

matching.instructions: Match the terms (1–5) with the correct definitions (A–F). There is one extra definition that you do not need (Questions 1–5).

definitions.text: Pain in the hands and arms caused by doing the same movements many times, especially when using a keyboard or mouse.
Unnecessary parts of a computer program that use more computing power than they should and give users little benefit.
If a computer does this, it stops responding to inputs.
Proof that you have passed an examination or course, showing your level of skill or knowledge in a subject.
A file in an issue tracking system that records a reported problem and the steps taken to solve it.
To pass a problem to a higher level of support because it is more serious.

items.explanation: Ticket (phiếu sự cố) là bản ghi trong hệ thống theo dõi sự cố, lưu vấn đề được báo và các bước xử lý.
Escalate (chuyển cấp) là chuyển sự cố lên cấp hỗ trợ cao hơn vì nó nghiêm trọng hơn.
Hang (treo máy): máy tính không còn phản hồi thao tác của người dùng.
RSI (Repetitive Strain Injury, chấn thương do lặp lại) là đau tay và cánh tay do lặp đi lặp lại một động tác, ví dụ gõ phím, dùng chuột.
Qualification (bằng cấp, chứng chỉ) cho thấy bạn đã qua một kỳ thi hoặc khoá học. Định nghĩa B là của bloatware (phần mềm thừa tính năng), không có trong danh sách thuật ngữ.

grammar.stem: I ______ the graphics card drivers yesterday, but the problem is still there.
grammar.explanation: Có mốc thời gian quá khứ xác định (yesterday) nên dùng quá khứ đơn "updated", không dùng hiện tại hoàn thành.

Trong câu phủ định thì hiện tại hoàn thành, dùng "yet" ở cuối câu (chưa…). "already" dùng trong câu khẳng định; "just" không đứng cuối câu như vậy; "ago" đi với quá khứ đơn và cần khoảng thời gian phía trước.

grammar.stem: After I graduate, I hope ______ a job as a network engineer.
grammar.explanation: hope + to-infinitive để nói về kế hoạch, mong muốn tương lai: "hope to find".

grammar.stem: All the lights on the router are off. It ______ be working.
grammar.explanation: Đèn tắt hết nên gần như chắc chắn router không hoạt động: dùng "can't" để phỏng đoán điều không thể. "must/has to" lại có nghĩa là chắc chắn đang hoạt động.

grammar.stem: The computer is very slow, and the network light is flashing fast. It ______ be downloading updates in the background.
grammar.explanation: Phỏng đoán khả năng đang diễn ra: might + be + V-ing. Đèn mạng nháy nhanh cho thấy có thể đang tải, nên "can't" không hợp; "mustn't" là cấm đoán; "doesn't be" sai ngữ pháp.

grammar.stem: If the computer starts to run very slowly again, you ______ save your work and restart it.
grammar.explanation: Đưa lời khuyên trong câu điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, you should + V. "must to" và "ought" (thiếu to) sai; "would" không dùng với vế If ở hiện tại đơn.

grammar.stem: If the wi-fi signal is weak, try ______ closer to the router.
grammar.explanation: Gợi ý giải pháp: try + V-ing (thử làm gì): "try moving". "to moving", "move", "moved" không đúng sau "try" trong cấu trúc này.

vocabulary.stem: Maria works in a ______ centre, where she answers customers' questions by phone.
vocabulary.explanation: Call centre (tổng đài) là nơi nhân viên trả lời câu hỏi của khách qua điện thoại.

vocabulary.stem: The message on the screen gave an error ______ that the technician could look up: 0x0004.
vocabulary.explanation: Error code (mã lỗi) là dãy số, chữ hoặc ký hiệu cho biết lỗi gì đã xảy ra.

vocabulary.stem: Don't open emails from people you don't know. They might contain a ______.
vocabulary.explanation: Virus là đoạn mã độc bí mật cài vào máy tính, có thể phá huỷ dữ liệu và lây qua email.

vocabulary.stem: The ______ explains how to set up the new scanner.
vocabulary.explanation: Manual (sách hướng dẫn) là tài liệu hướng dẫn cách dùng máy.

vocabulary.stem: Don't ______ the cable too much, or the wires inside it may break.
vocabulary.explanation: Bend (bẻ cong, gập) là làm cho vật không còn thẳng; gập cáp quá nhiều có thể làm đứt dây bên trong.

vocabulary.stem: Never open the power supply unit. You could get an electric ______.
vocabulary.explanation: Electric shock (điện giật) là cú sốc đột ngột lên cơ thể do dòng điện.

vocabulary.stem: Send your ______ with your job application. It should list your education and the jobs you have done.
vocabulary.explanation: CV (Curriculum Vitae, sơ yếu lý lịch) liệt kê quá trình học tập và các công việc đã làm, gửi kèm đơn xin việc.

vocabulary.stem: During the summer, I got some useful work ______ at a software company.
vocabulary.explanation: Work experience (kinh nghiệm làm việc) là trải nghiệm có được khi làm một loại công việc.

passage.title: Problems with the Staff App at Lakeview Hotel
paragraphs: Three weeks ago, Lakeview Hotel started using a new app for its cleaning and maintenance staff. Staff use the app on their phones to see which rooms need cleaning and to report repairs. About forty staff use the app every day. Since the first week, however, there have been problems. The app has crashed many times, usually when staff try to upload photos of broken items.

Kenji, the hotel's IT officer, has investigated the problem. So far, he has updated the app on every phone and checked the hotel's wi-fi. He has also asked three members of staff to write down the time of every crash. When he switched off the wi-fi on a test phone and used mobile data instead, the app crashed in exactly the same way, so the hotel's wi-fi can't be the cause. He has also noticed that the crashes only happen on older phones and never on the new models that the managers use.

Kenji thinks that the problem might be the size of the photos. Older phones have less memory, and the app could be running out of memory when it processes large images. He hasn't contacted the app developer yet, but he plans to send them a report this afternoon.

Until the developer releases an update, Kenji has suggested a simple solution. Staff should try reducing the photo size in the camera settings. If the app still crashes, they should describe the problem in words instead of sending a photo. Kenji will look at the results at the end of the week.

questions.stem: When does the app usually crash?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: ứng dụng bị sập "usually when staff try to upload photos of broken items".

questions.stem: Why is Kenji sure that the wi-fi is not the cause?

options.text: The app works without a network.
The app also crashes without the wi-fi.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: khi tắt wi-fi và dùng dữ liệu di động, ứng dụng vẫn sập y như cũ, "so the hotel's wi-fi can't be the cause". Ứng dụng không chạy tốt khi không có wi-fi (B sai).

questions.stem: On which phones does the app crash?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: "the crashes only happen on older phones and never on the new models that the managers use".

options.text: Updated the app on every phone
Asked staff to record the crashes

questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: "He hasn't contacted the app developer yet". Cập nhật ứng dụng, kiểm tra wi-fi và nhờ nhân viên ghi lại thời điểm sập là những việc đã làm.

questions.stem: What has Kenji suggested that staff should try?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4: "Staff should try reducing the photo size in the camera settings."

passageTrueFalse.instructions: Read the passage and write T (True) or F (False) (Questions 26–30).

passage.title: From Help Desk to Network Engineer
paragraphs: Linh Tran is twenty-six and works as a support technician at a bank in Hanoi. She studied computer science and finished her degree in 2021. Since then, she has worked at the bank's help desk, where she answers calls from staff and solves problems with their computers and accounts. She has been at the bank for almost five years.

Linh enjoys helping people, but she hopes to become a network engineer one day. Last year, she started an evening course in computer networks, which she attends twice a week. She has already completed the first part of the course, and she expects to finish the second part in December.

Her manager has agreed to let her spend one day a month with the bank's network team. Linh intends to apply for a junior network engineer position when the course ends. In the long term, she plans to work abroad, possibly in Singapore or Australia. She says the most important thing that she has learned at the help desk is how to explain technical problems in simple words.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: "She studied computer science and finished her degree in 2021."

questions.statement: Linh has worked in the bank's network team since 2021.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: từ 2021 Linh làm ở bộ phận hỗ trợ (help desk). Đoạn 3: cô chỉ được dành một ngày mỗi tháng với nhóm mạng.

questions.statement: Linh attends her evening course twice a week.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: khoá học buổi tối "which she attends twice a week".

questions.statement: Linh expects to finish the second part of the course in June.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: cô dự kiến hoàn thành phần hai "in December".

questions.statement: Linh plans to work in Vietnam for her whole career.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: về lâu dài "she plans to work abroad, possibly in Singapore or Australia".

bullets: thank Ben for reporting the problem
already: run a virus scan / no viruses found
not yet: check the hard drive
possible causes: the old hard drive / too many programs start automatically
try closing programs Ben doesn't use / bring the laptop to the IT office on Friday if it is still slow
targetGrammar: Present perfect with already and yet: I have already run…; I haven't checked… yet
Speculating about causes: may, might, could
Suggesting solutions: should; try + -ing; If…, you should…
email.modelAnswer:
Dear Ben,

Thank you for reporting the problem with your laptop. I have already run a virus scan, and I didn't find any viruses. I have also deleted some old temporary files. However, I haven't checked the hard drive yet. The problem might be the old hard drive, or it could be that too many programs start automatically. For now, try closing any programs that you don't use. If the laptop is still slow, you should bring it to the IT office on Friday.

Best regards,
Anna

parts.instructions: Answer the three questions. Speak for 30–45 seconds for each question.
questions: What have you already done this week for your studies, and what haven't you done yet? Use the present perfect with already and yet.
A friend's phone battery runs out very quickly. What advice can you give? Use should, try + -ing or If…, you should….
What do you hope to do in the next five years? Use plan to, intend to, hope to or expect to.

parts.instructions: Speculate about the cause of a problem. Speak for 1–1.5 minutes.
parts.prompt: You are helping a colleague in a meeting room. The projector shows no picture from the laptop. Look at the facts in the cues and explain what might, could, must or can't be the cause. Then say what your colleague should try. Use may, might, could, must and can't.
cues: the projector's power light is on
the video cable is connected only at the laptop end
another laptop worked with this projector this morning
requiredGrammar: Speculation: may, might, could (possible); must (almost certain); can't (impossible)
parts.sampleAnswer: Let's think about this. The power light on the projector is on, so it can't be a problem with the electricity. Another laptop worked with this projector this morning, so the projector can't be broken. The screen says 'No signal', which means the projector isn't receiving anything from your laptop. Look at the video cable: it's only connected at the laptop end. That must be the reason. Someone may have moved the cable after the last meeting. If it still doesn't work after we connect it, the problem might be the laptop's display settings, or it could be that the laptop isn't sending a picture to a second screen. In that case, you should try pressing the function key with the screen symbol.

parts.instructions: Deal with the situation. Speak for 1–1.5 minutes.
parts.prompt: You are at an interview for a junior IT support job. The interviewer asks you to talk about your experience and your plans. Use the present perfect for your experience (I have worked…, I have already…) and plan to, hope to, intend to or expect to for your plans.
cues: your studies: subject / when you expect to graduate
experience: part-time help desk job at university / what you have done there
plans: what you hope to do in this job / a course you intend to take
in five years: what you plan to do
requiredGrammar: Present perfect for experience: I have worked…, I have already learned…
Future plans: plan to, hope to, intend to, expect to + verb
parts.sampleAnswer: Thank you for inviting me. I'm studying information technology, and I expect to graduate next June. For the last two years, I have worked part-time at the university help desk. I have answered hundreds of calls from students and teachers, and I have set up laptops for new staff. I have already learned how to install operating systems and how to solve common network problems. I have also improved my communication skills, because many users are not very technical. In this job, I hope to learn more about servers and security. I intend to take a networking course next year. In five years, I plan to work as a network engineer, maybe in a large international company.
